metadata.name: toothfairy_escrow
metadata.description: Tooth Fairy Network — Soulbound NFT milestones with escrow deposits on Solana

instructions.name: claim_asset_deposit
docs: Guardian releases a matured asset deposit to the child's token account.

instructions.name: claim_deposit
docs: Claim a specific deposit — transfers escrowed SOL to the child's wallet.
Only the guardian can trigger this (parental control).
Respects time-lock: cannot claim before lock_until.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config — checked for pause state

instructions.name: claim_token_deposit
docs: Release a matured USDC deposit to the child's token account.

instructions.name: close_deposit
docs: Close a deposit account and reclaim rent.
Only callable after the deposit has been claimed or refunded (amount_lamports == 0).
Rent is returned to the guardian's wallet.

instructions.name: close_milestone
docs: Close a milestone account and reclaim rent.
Only the guardian can call this. All deposits for this milestone must be claimed or refunded.
Rent is returned to the guardian's wallet.
Refused since Vault 2.0: every USDC and asset release needs its milestone account, and this
account cannot see those balances, so closing it could strand a child's money for good.
The account layout is unchanged so existing clients still decode the instruction.

instructions.name: close_profile
docs: Close a child profile and reclaim rent.
Only the guardian can call this. All milestones must be closed first.
Rent is returned to the guardian's wallet.
Only a profile with no milestones can close: its totals count SOL only, so a USDC or asset
balance would be invisible here, and anyone could re-create the closed address as its guardian.

instructions.name: close_settled_asset_deposit
docs: Return a settled asset deposit's rent (its record and its empty vault) to whoever paid it.
Only the original depositor signs, so nobody else can erase a family's gift record.
Deposit indexes only ever increase, so a closed address is never reused.

instructions.name: create_milestone
docs: Create a milestone record for a tooth.
The keepsake cNFT is minted separately via Bubblegum.
Only the guardian can call this.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit SOL into an existing milestone's escrow.
ANYONE can call this — parents, grandparents, uncles, friends.
Each deposit is tracked as a separate Deposit account.
A 2% platform fee is deducted and sent to the treasury.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Platform treasury — receives the 2% fee

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config — checked for pause state

instructions.name: deposit_asset
docs: Deposit an allowlisted asset into a deposit-specific vault.
Aggregates are kept per milestone and per mint, so assets never sum together.

instructions.name: deposit_token
docs: Deposit canonical USDC into a deposit-specific token vault.
The fee and net amount remain independently verifiable token balances.

instructions.name: early_withdraw
docs: Early withdrawal — guardian can withdraw a time-locked deposit before maturity.
The full protected amount goes to the child wallet; no second platform fee is charged.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Platform treasury retained for instruction compatibility; no early-release fee is collected.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config — checked for pause state

instructions.name: early_withdraw_asset_deposit
docs: Guardian releases a still-locked asset deposit early, without a second fee.

instructions.name: early_withdraw_token_deposit
docs: Release a still-locked USDC deposit early without charging a second platform fee.

instructions.name: get_milestones
docs: Get all milestones for a child (read-only — clients use getProgramAccounts).

instructions.name: initialize_asset_config
docs: Allowlist one SPL asset with its own minimum and fee. Config authority only.

instructions.name: initialize_child
docs: Initialize a new child profile that tracks milestones.
Called once per child by the parent (guardian).
V2 CHANGE: PDA seeded by child_wallet only (not guardian).
This allows guardianship transfer without breaking PDA derivation.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initialize the global config. Called once by the platform admin.

instructions.name: initialize_token_config
docs: Configure the one allowlisted six-decimal stablecoin mint for this cluster.
This is additive and does not alter any existing SOL account.

instructions.name: initialize_treasury
docs: Initialize the platform treasury. Called once by the platform admin.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause the contract — blocks deposits, claims, withdrawals, and transfers.
Only the config authority can call this.

instructions.name: refund_asset_deposit
docs: Original depositor reclaims the net asset amount during the grace period.

instructions.name: refund_deposit
docs: Refund a deposit back to the original depositor.
Only the ORIGINAL DEPOSITOR can call this.
Only works within the 7-day grace period after deposit.
Cannot refund if already claimed.

instructions.name: refund_token_deposit
docs: Return a USDC deposit to its original depositor during the grace period.

instructions.name: transfer_config_authority
docs: Transfer emergency/config control to a new authority, such as a multisig vault.

instructions.name: transfer_guardianship
docs: Transfer guardianship of a child profile to a new wallet.
Only the current guardian can call this.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config — checked for pause state

instructions.name: transfer_treasury_authority
docs: Transfer SOL-fee treasury control to a new authority, such as a multisig vault.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Unpause the contract — resumes normal operation.
Only the config authority can call this.

instructions.name: update_asset_config
docs: Change an asset's minimum, fee or new-deposit switch. Config authority only.
Disabling stops new deposits; claims, refunds and early releases keep working.

instructions.name: update_child_wallet
docs: Update the child's destination wallet.
Only the guardian can call this.

instructions.name: withdraw_asset_treasury
docs: Withdraw collected fees of one asset to the config authority's token account.

instructions.name: withdraw_token_treasury
docs: Withdraw collected USDC fees to the configured authority's token account.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Withdraw accumulated fees from the treasury.
Only the treasury authority can call this.

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: One allowlisted SPL asset with its own rules. Its classic ATA is the asset's fee treasury.
PDA: ["asset_config", mint]

types.name: AssetMilestone
docs: Per-milestone, per-asset aggregates, so different assets never sum together.
PDA: ["asset_milestone", milestone, mint]

types.name: ChildProfile
docs: Child profile — tracks milestones and deposits for one child.
V2 CHANGE: PDA seeded by child_wallet only (not guardian).
PDA: ["child_profile", child_wallet]

types.name: Config
docs: Global config — emergency pause and platform settings.
PDA: ["config"] (global singleton)

types.name: Deposit
docs: Individual deposit — one per depositor per milestone.
The deposit PDA itself holds the escrowed SOL.

types.name: TokenConfig
docs: Cluster-specific allowlist for the one accepted stablecoin mint.
PDA: ["token_config"]

types.name: TokenDeposit
docs: One allowlisted-token deposit. Its ATA is the token vault.
PDA: ["token_deposit", milestone, deposit_index]

types.name: TokenMilestone
docs: Token aggregates kept separate from the deployed Milestone layout.
PDA: ["token_milestone", milestone]

types.name: Treasury
docs: Platform treasury collects the 2% funding fee.
Single global PDA seeded by ["treasury"].
